r20.name: R20 — Plasticity Stress
r20.subtitle: Long-horizon continual learning on Permuted-MNIST with a shared classifier.

lambda_.observation: Moderate controlled norm reduction (lambda ~ 1e-2) performs best; excessive regularization (lambda = 1e-1) becomes harmful.

radial.note: radial-coefficient sweep; gamma=0 is plain SGD; matched step
radial.observation: Increasing inward radial allocation reduces the parameter norm monotonically, but accuracy does not improve monotonically: a mild bias beats SGD while strong inward steering collapses learning. Norm reduction alone is not sufficient.

ablation.observation: In this ablation, removing the per-unit norm cap (revive-only) improves accuracy relative to full ANR, whereas removing revival (shrink-only) is associated with lower accuracy, greater plasticity decay, and more dormant units. These results implicate the cap as a contributor to ANR's underperformance in the evaluated regime, but do not establish it as the sole cause.
